lines.context: 双机实测 §6Wisp Upgrade Stone 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: Upgrades a Glacial Wisp pet to a Subzero Wisp pet, resetting its level.
lines.raw: §7Upgrades a §5Glacial Wisp §7pet to a §6Subzero Wisp §7pet, resetting its level.
lines.zh: 将冰川鬼火宠物升级为零下鬼火宠物，并重置其等级。

lines.context: 双机实测 §dFairy Griffin Skin 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: This skin will allow you to swap between 20 fairy themed griffins!
lines.raw: §aThis skin will allow you to swap §abetween 20 fairy themed griffins!
lines.zh: 此皮肤可让你在 20 种仙灵主题的狮鹫外观之间切换!

lines.context: 双机实测 §dGhost Mithril Golem Skin 的完整 Lore 说明。
lines.text: This skin will allow you to swap between 14 ghost themed golems!
lines.raw: §aThis skin will allow you to swap §abetween 14 ghost themed golems!
lines.zh: 此皮肤可让你在 14 种幽灵主题的傀儡外观之间切换!
